page.overview:
Who is Bertrand Gachot?

Bertrand Gachot (; born 23 December 1962 in Luxembourg, Canton of Luxembourg, District of Luxembourg, Luxembourg) is a Luxembourg-born French former racing driver, probably best known for his arrest that lead to the début of seven-time World Champion Michael Schumacher. He initially drove in Formula One under a Belgian racing licence, but switched to French in .

He made his début at the first race of the season for , failing to pre-qualify for the first six races and only finishing twice before being fired after complaining about the amount of testing time. He drove for the team for the final two races, failing to qualify both races. was even worse. Driving for , he failed to qualify for all sixteen races, not getting out of pre-qualifying for the first ten.

Gachot drove the season with Larrousse, scoring a solitary point but retiring in most of the races. He failed to find a seat in . He returned in for the team, only qualifying for five races in his first season and only making two finishes from eleven starts in his next season, . Pacific folded at the end of the year and Gachot's career was over.
